notes.title: Corsair's Madness Patch 1
notes.notes:
1. Fixed getting stuck in this location if you didn't kill the wolf from above -

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/46ec3edbb1b22f0efb2f799622482ccb64681060.png

2. Fixed the possibility of getting stuck between the platform and the ceiling in the location with buttons -

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/7c4bab66bdc35566724fdc0f6d5b1c9b1d888407.png

3. Fixed the possibility of flying out of the level when using the cloud in this location -

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41594160/2f83bb8be0166b4aca08c275390061f2c0978086.png

4. [spoiler]It is now possible to buy all items in the store before the last boss.[/spoiler]



Much appreciation for the bug report to:

- quithate
- Александр Сычев

notes.title: Corsair`s Madness Prologue: Jungle`s Island RELEASE on 3.02
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43131581/ad38149604c7ee12a28b9683fc5fbdbd50e60608.png

Hey everyone, it's time to share the release date of the prologue. 

On Friday, 3.02, you can finally try out an entire island to explore!
What awaits you as early as TOMORROW:

 The story's plot
 5 levels
 3 bosses
 Playing as a character with two different combat systems
 Puzzle solving
 Boat battles
 Equipment upgrades


Link to prolouge version https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190570/Corsairs_Madness_Prologue_Jungles_Island
